hook.name: CrimeFeeHook
hook.description: Post-graduation fee hook for CRIME token pools that applies a dynamic fee ladder based on market cap (via ETH/USD Chainlink oracle or keeper-pushed scalar), taking protocol and creator slices on every swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, and distributing fees across configurable destinations including buyback-burn, liquidity donation, and a diamond-cut staking vault.
